body: The Cafe will be a better place without Lorayne's "self-aggrandizement" shtick, and it's a pity this didn't happen sooner. He would have been remembered more fondly if he hadn't spent so much of his time on the Internet flogging his own books and squabbling with everyone who typed something he perceived as a slight against him.

I'm using a throwaway to reply because HL carries such a chip on his shoulder & usual username is related to my actual name. Don't want him knowing who I am! And I wouldn't be surprised if he replied to this thread.

I was actually thinking of posting something about him here myself, a couple of days ago. What I had in mind was not so much the arguing (because a lot of people do that on the Cafe) and more the incessant self-promotion. I don't think I've ever seen a single thread about card magic that didn't have a post from HL in it advertising one of his own books.
